svg.title: How toon-crew works: from ask to merge
svg.desc: How toon-crew works, in eight steps. 1: You ask in plain words. 2: Doraemon, the main agent, plans the work, queues it and briefs the crew; memory (agent lessons and project.md) feeds every brief. 3: The crew works inside the Guard, which checks risky calls and asks you or refuses. Builders (Backend, Frontend, DevOps) each work in their own git worktree; Docs writes; Security, QA, Research and Helpers review and test read-only. 4: Each crew member writes hand-back files, a full report and a short summary. 5: Doraemon reads the summary, checks the work and commits. 6: He opens a pull request and CI checks run. 7: You approve; the Guard asks you first. 8: DevOps (Mike or Sulley) merges. Add-on: the Crew Room board lets you watch it live.
svg.text: Guard: checks risky calls, asks you or refuses
